nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Contributor guide for the @opencode-ai/sdk package: documents the parallel v1/v2 generated client structure, the responseStyle/throwOnError error-handling contract, generator limitations that force post-generation patching in script/build.ts, the downstream typecheck gate to run after regeneration, and test conventions in packages/opencode/test/server/.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @opencode-ai/sdk defining the export map (root, client, server, v2, v2/client, v2/gen/client), the @hey-api/openapi-ts dev dependency for client generation, a cross-spawn runtime dependency, and build/typecheck scripts that run script/build.ts and tsgo.
nodes.languageNotes: The exports map points at raw TypeScript sources (src/index.ts, src/v2/index.ts) rather than dist output — the workspace symlink makes src edits live for in-repo consumers without a build step, while the files field publishes only dist to npm.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the SDK package extending @tsconfig/node22 with nodenext module resolution, composite project references, declaration emit to dist, and DOM libs required by the generated fetch-based client types.
